notes: 2026-02-18 demo w/ AE + SE (Ruth / Diego) — ran through two-stage retrieval plan; CTO (L. Patel) reiterated strict latency needs: "cannot exceed 250ms p95 for end-to-end answer or CSAT drops".
POC scope agreed 3 weeks: week1 index 1M sample (subset of 20M corpus), week2 candidate recall + ANN tuning, week3 cross-encoder rerank and production-like traffic soak (10k qps/day peak emulation).
Indexing scale: anticipated corpus ~20M support artifacts (tickets, KB articles, transcripts). Avg doc length ~600 tokens. Want shard/partition guidance for Dedicated pools.
Embeddings: currently using 1536-d vector pipeline (in-house) — open to Redwood recommendations (quantized 768 or 1024) to save cost but maintain top-5 rerank quality.
Search architecture preference: ANN for fast recall (candidate set 100) -> cross-encoder re-ranker for top-5. Target top-5 relevance: >90% human precision (QA on held-out prompts).
Latency targets: p50 end-to-end (ANN+rerank) 120ms, p95 <= 350ms. Cost target: <$0.005 per query at current traffic mix (70% low-complexity, 30% long-form).
Current stack: ElasticSearch + custom BM25 prefilter, expensive cross-encoder hosted on CPU nodes. Pain points: high per-query cost, cache misses, and inconsistent tail latency under peak.

Security: requires SSO (SAML), KMS integration for key management, audit logs retained 1 year, data residency: must store customer PII in us-east region only. Air-gapped evaluation option requested for regulated customers.
Quote from Head of CX ops: "If you can hit p95 latency and reduce cost per ticket by 40% we'll move to Dedicated with a 12-month commit".
Evaluation metrics agreed: recall@100, MRR@5, human-eval precision@5, p50/p95 latency, token cost breakdown. SE will instrument tracing for cost attribution.
Logistics: legal provided standard NDA; security sent questionnaire (drive link). Next SE deliverable: test harness & synthetic traffic script by 2026-03-10.
Jira items created: INF-4123 (POC infra requests), SEC-719 (data residency controls).
Blockers noted on call: VPC peering timeline (internal networking team), approval for GPU footprint from infra budget, review of retention policy by legal.
